note: Main sidebar chrome -- renders: user status, fixed icon buttons (Home, Messages, etc.), and footer links; the rooms-list is subtracted as it renders user-created channel names
Sidebar top bar -- renders: fixed section title (e.g. 'Channels') and fixed icon buttons
Sidebar section headers -- renders: fixed category labels (e.g. 'Channels', 'Direct Messages')
Directory tabs -- renders: fixed tab labels (e.g. 'Channels', 'People', 'Groups')
Table headers -- renders: fixed column labels (e.g. 'Name', 'Topic', 'Members')
Pagination controls -- renders: fixed navigation buttons and page numbers
Page heading -- renders: fixed page title (e.g. 'Directory')
